Work / Premium Positioning System / Tortino
Restaurant · Repositioning

Tortino Restaurant.

From a generic franchise-builder template to a candlelit Tuscan trattoria in the heart of DC.

Tortino's original site was a Hibu small-business template — stock photography, a review-widget bolted to the header, and copy that could describe any Italian restaurant in America. The repositioning finds Tortino's actual story (a family kitchen from outside Lucca) and lets the food and room carry the brand instead of a generic offer stack.

Role
Brand Reposition · UI Redesign
Industry
Restaurant · Italian Fine Dining
Scope
Full Site Rebuild

Concept & Intent.

The old site read like a directory listing — a review widget in the header, a stock skyline photo, and copy so generic it never once mentioned pasta, wine, or Tuscany by name.

The redesign opens with the family story from outside Lucca, then lets five signature dishes and a candlelit dining room do the selling. Every section earns its place: this is a restaurant worth a reservation, not a listing worth a click.

Before & After
Before Hibu Website Builder
  • Review-widget bar and phone number crammed above the logo — no room to breathe
  • Generic "Authentic Italian Cuisine" headline that could belong to any restaurant
  • Stock skyline photo instead of the food, the room, or the people
  • Four-column feature list is the entire "brand" — no menu, no story, no atmosphere
After Custom Build
  • Specific, ownable headline — "Taste Authentic Tuscany in the Heart of Washington"
  • Family story from outside Lucca replaces the generic "About" boilerplate
  • Five signature dishes, priced and photographed, do the selling before any CTA
  • Candlelit gallery and guest quote build the room's actual atmosphere
